debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.title: On Demand Loading
debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.description:
This settings page is provided by On-Demand Symbols, a custom extension for Unreal Engine.

View real-time status and diagnostics in the Output window (Show output from: "On-Demand Symbols").

debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.statsS.title: Startup Acceleration Stats
debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.statsS.description: Total PDB symbol loads avoided and estimated time saved by On-Demand Symbols during Unreal Editor boots.

debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.totalP.title: Lifetime PDBs Avoided
debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.totalP.description: Total number of unnecessary PDB symbol loads skipped during editor startup.

debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.estima.title: Estimated Time Saved
debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.estima.description: Total developer startup wait time saved across all editor launches (based on symbols accounting for ~50% of boot time).

debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.lastLa.title: Last Launch Savings
debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.lastLa.description: PDBs skipped and estimated time saved during the most recent editor startup.

debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.breakS.title: Break Symbol Loading
debugging.symbols.onDemandLoading.breakS.description: Controls symbol loading when execution breaks or context changes.
enumItemLabels: LocalOnly (Adjacent, local paths, and local cache)
Off (Do not automatically load symbols on break)
All (Query remote symbol servers if needed)
